name: codetogether
description: Real-time collaborative coding for VS Code.

commands.title: Join a Session in New Window

viewsWelcome.contents:
Invite others to join your session by sharing the link. 
[Copy Link](command:codetogether.copyInviteLink)

A shared terminal allows all participants to see the terminal output and input commands. 
[Create Terminal](command:codetogether.createSharedTerminal)

Share a local server with all participants. 
[Share Server](command:codetogether.shareServer)

codetogether.userName.description: User name to display to other participants. If empty, will detect from available accounts or ask for a name.

codetogether.approveGuests.description: Ask the host to approve each guest before they join.

codetogether.defaultGuestCanEdit.description: Allow newly approved guests to edit by default.

codetogether.trystero.description: The first parameter of trystero.joinRoom, see https://github.com/dmotz/trystero.

codetogether.terminal.dimensionsSource.description: Determines how terminal dimensions are calculated for shared terminals.
